title: When the Alibi Falls
author: Beatrix Almeida
blurb: Bram Dravenmoor, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
